name: back-to-wall-shoulder-flexion
instructions:
1. Setup in a standing position with your back against a wall and your feet roughly 6-8 inches away from the base of the wall.
2. Exhale and slowly raise the arms overhead as you try to touch your thumbs to the wall.
3. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
